svg.text: Mixed-dispatch and nonsingularity component snapshot
Mixed dispatcher / field - reviewed
Original point/divisor polynomial validity and four nonzero weights over a field imply a valid nonzero-
weight Some payload in every degree1+2 branch; explicit and nested None branches excluded.
Mixed dispatcher / UInt64 - reviewed
Prime 5<=p<2^31, canonical inputs/curve coefficients, n=1 and tables=None, four nonzero weights and original
normalized validity imply canonical valid payload in literal source order.
Repeated-support tripling / field - reviewed
Original mixed-input validity and the repeated positive-support guards establish nonzero output weights and
polynomial validity for the literal tripling payload.
Repeated-support tripling / UInt64 - reviewed
Canonical input and prime bounds as above; raw constants 5,8,10 handled by explicit no-overflow/reduction
correspondence, including p=5 and p=7. Scoped Some and validity composition.
Degree2 equal-arm guard exclusion - reviewed
Over a field with 2!=0, crossed ordinate equality and earlier inverse guard false exclude the nested b=0,s=0
identity arm. Does not exclude direct-call identity or prove doubling output validity.
Same-u extracted point - reviewed
Original two Mumford divisibilities, noninverse and nonzero slope difference give a valid extracted point.
Four nonzero weights connect the exact field expression to normalized coordinates. Singular zero-ordinate
example retained.
Local nonsingularity bridge - reviewed
Zero extracted ordinate forces a square factor and simultaneous value/derivative zero. Explicit local
exclusion gives ordinate nonzero; with 2!=0 and four nonzero weights, subsequent doubling yields valid
nonzero-weight output.
Global coprimality bridge - reviewed
IsCoprime f f.derivative supplies Bezout exclusion at every x, then the local premise and nonzero extracted
ordinate. Arbitrary field; characteristic-five controls pass; not a geometric characteristic-two smoothness
assertion.
